Alertmanager alert KubeContainerWaiting (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/kube-prometheus-stack-kube-state-metrics since 2026-11-26T04:20:08Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The KubeContainerWaiting alert for pod otel-demo/recommendation-59897fb7d5-htb9k is caused by the ConfigMap otel-demo/recommendation-config holding invalid JSON in its 'config' key: '{"configuration_items": [{"name": fake}]}' with the value fake unquoted. The pod's init container worker runs /bin/sh -c 'python3.14 ~/scripts/load_config.py', which loads that key as ~/config/config.json and exits 1 on a JSON parse error; the container logged 'FATAL: Failed to parse configuration file: Expecting value: line 4 column 21 (char 61)', which is exactly the position of the unquoted fake. The init container has restarted 6 times with last termination reason Error/exitCode 1, the kubelet logged 10 BackOff events for container worker, and the main recommendation container consequently stays in waiting state reason PodInitializing, which is the condition the KubeContainerWaiting rule (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason > 0, reason != CrashLoopBackOff) evaluates to 1. Only the new ReplicaSet recommendation-59897fb7d5 has this init container and its pod is stuck; the previous ReplicaSet's pod recommendation-6f54ffddc7-vt4sn is Running and Ready, so the recommendation service still produces spans. Deployment recommendation shows replicas 2, ready 1, updated 1. Both the deployment (generation 2) and the ConfigMap were created/updated at 2026-11-26T04:19:19Z by the manager 'OpenAPI-Generator'; change history is not integrated, so what triggered that write is not observable.

claims.text: Pod otel-demo/recommendation-59897fb7d5-htb9k was created 2026-11-26T04:19:19Z, is in phase Pending on node kind-environment-worker, and its main container 'recommendation' is in state waiting with reason PodInitializing (ready=false, started=false); its init container 'worker' has restartCount 6 and is terminated with exitCode 1, reason Error, startedAt/finishedAt 2026-11-26T04:25:03Z, with a previous termination also exitCode 1 at 2026-11-26T04:22:22Z. Its owner is ReplicaSet recommendation-59897fb7d5.

Kubelet events for pod recommendation-59897fb7d5-htb9k include 10 BackOff events with message 'Back-off restarting failed container worker in pod recommendation-59897fb7d5-htb9k_otel-demo(eb5433dd-3ba7-4622-ac87-2853a371c037)' between 2026-11-26T04:19:24Z and 2026-11-26T04:25:04Z, together with 7 'Container created' and 7 'Container started' events for the same pod.

The init container worker of pod recommendation-59897fb7d5-htb9k logged at 2026-11-26T04:25:03.549643795Z: 'FATAL: Failed to parse configuration file: Expecting value: line 4 column 21 (char 61)'; the main container recommendation has no current log because it is waiting to start (PodInitializing) and has no previous instance.

Deployment otel-demo/recommendation declares container 'recommendation' plus init container 'worker' (image registry.access.redhat.com/ubi10/python-314-minimal:10.3-1795234906@sha256:6a3ac934913b426ccf9a9d8406084e47044ef8da88a6722a3acc60ac990595c3, command /bin/sh, args '-c' 'python3.14 ~/scripts/load_config.py') and mounts volumes 'config' (configMap recommendation-config key config -> config.json) and 'scripts' (key script -> load_config.py); its status is replicas 2, ready 1, available 1, updated 1.

Two ReplicaSets exist for recommendation: recommendation-6f54ffddc7 (created 2026-11-26T04:11:54Z, 1 replica, readyReplicas 1, no init containers) and recommendation-59897fb7d5 (created 2026-11-26T04:19:19Z, 1 replica, initContainers ['worker'], no ready replicas). Pod recommendation-6f54ffddc7-vt4sn from the older ReplicaSet is Running and Ready (container recommendation started 2026-11-26T04:11:55Z, restartCount 0).

ConfigMap recommendation-config was created 2026-11-26T04:19:19Z with managedFields entry manager 'OpenAPI-Generator', operation Update, time 2026-11-26T04:19:19Z; deployment recommendation was updated at the same instant by manager 'OpenAPI-Generator' (operation Update) and by kube-controller-manager (status subresource), reaching generation 2, and it is the only otel-demo deployment with a managed-field write at or after 2026-11-26T04:15:00Z.

Metric kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace="otel-demo",pod="recommendation-59897fb7d5-htb9k",container="recommendation",reason="PodInitializing",uid="eb5433dd-3ba7-4622-ac87-2853a371c037"} equals 1 at every sampled point from 2026-11-26T04:20:08Z through 2026-11-26T04:25:08Z; the alerting rule KubeContainerWaiting in group kubernetes-apps uses query kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{job="kube-state-metrics",namespace=~".*",reason!="CrashLoopBackOff"} > 0, has duration 300s, and is firing with value 1e+00 and activeAt 2026-11-26T04:20:08Z.

The ConfigMap otel-demo/recommendation-config contains malformed JSON, so the init container's load_config.py necessarily hits the json.JSONDecodeError branch and exits 1, which is the observed repeated Error termination of container worker; that failed init container keeps the main container in PodInitializing, the exact waiting reason the alert reports.

Pod recommendation-59897fb7d5-htb9k is the only pod in namespace otel-demo that is not Running or not fully ready at query time (all other 26 pods in the namespace are Running and ready); the only other pod-level warning event in otel-demo is one Unhealthy event for pod otel-collector-74d749ff5f-dgqxl at 2026-11-26T04:11:58Z ('Readiness probe failed: Get "http://10.244.1.65:13133/": dial tcp 10.244.1.65:13133: connect: connection refused'), a startup probe miss on a different pod.

The recommendation service was still serving through the older pod: spans with service_name=recommendation show an increase of about 720 spans with status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET in the 5 minutes ending 2026-11-26T04:25:08Z, with a small STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase (~1.19 spans) appearing only at 2026-11-26T04:25:08Z in the 10-minute query; these span counts come from the running pod recommendation-6f54ffddc7-vt4sn, and the low error figure is not tied to the init-container failure.

The flagd fault-injection scenario 'recommendationCacheFailure' (and every other flag in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config, e.g. adFailure, cartFailure, paymentFailure) has defaultVariant 'off', so no flagd flag is shown as switched on; flagd also controls application runtime behavior, not the init container's JSON parse, which is the observed failure.

Image pull or scheduling delay is not the cause: the pod was Scheduled at 04:19:19Z, the init container image was pulled successfully in 2.422s at 04:19:22Z, and no FailedScheduling or FailedMount event exists for this pod; the worker actually started 7 times and failed on its own exit code 1.

The deployment change at 2026-11-26T04:19:19Z that introduced init container 'worker' together with the simultaneously created ConfigMap recommendation-config is what exposed the malformed JSON; the pod template change is the mechanism by which the bad configuration blocks startup, while the invalid content in the ConfigMap is the fault.

The alert text claims the container has been waiting 'longer than 1 hour', but pod recommendation-59897fb7d5-htb9k was created only at 2026-11-26T04:19:19Z and the rule's configured duration is 300s, so the '1 hour' wording does not match the observed pod age or rule duration.

gaps: Change history is not integrated (not_integrated: change_history), so the actor behind the 'OpenAPI-Generator' managed-field write at 2026-11-26T04:19:19Z that created ConfigMap recommendation-config and updated Deployment recommendation cannot be identified, and there is no record of what the previous ConfigMap content was.
Why the ConfigMap was written with unquoted JSON ('"name": fake') cannot be determined from cluster state; no source repository or CI record was available.

No application log line from the main container 'recommendation' of pod recommendation-59897fb7d5-htb9k exists because that container never started (PodInitializing), so its runtime behavior is unknown.

The alert annotation's '1 hour' wording is inconsistent with the pod's creation time (2026-11-26T04:19:19Z) and the rule's 300s duration; the reason for the mismatch is not determinable from the available data.

Impact on callers of the recommendation service was not established beyond span counts; no request-level success/failure measurement or downstream-specific check was performed, and spans of the running pod do not describe requests the missing replica would have served.
All 18 delivered views had status ok, incomplete false and truncated false; no view was cut short.
next_steps: Correct the JSON in ConfigMap otel-demo/recommendation-config (quote the value, e.g. "name": "fake") or restore the previous valid config content, then let the ReplicaSet recreate/retry the init container.

Confirm with the change owner of the 2026-11-26T04:19:19Z update (manager label 'OpenAPI-Generator') why the recommendation Deployment gained init container 'worker' and the ConfigMap content was written malformed.
After remediation, verify pod recommendation-59897fb7d5-htb9k reaches Running/Ready and that deployment recommendation reports readyReplicas equal to replicas (currently 1 of 2).

data.script:
import json
import os
import sys

def main():
    try:
        with open(os.path.expanduser("~/config/config.json"), "r") as f:
            data = json.load(f)

        items_count = len(data.get("configuration_items", []))

        print(f"Config loaded successfully with {items_count} configuration items")
        sys.exit(0)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        print(f"FATAL: Failed to parse configuration file: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FATAL: Unexpected error loading configuration: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
import os
import sys

def main():
    try:
        with open(os.path.expanduser("~/config/config.json"), "r") as f:

        items_count = len(data.get("configuration_items", []))

    except Exception as e:

        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
